第一卷 第653章 胜算（第1页）
说实话，对于今天晚上发生的事，他们都挺惊讶的。
他们都没想到当初引荐林芜进长墨的那个学长，会在今天晚上忽然上台引爆舆论。
祁煜洺有些懵，问贺长柏，“这是庭深他们刻意安排的戏码？怎么没听庭深说起过。”
贺长柏摇头：“不清楚，庭深也没跟我说。”
之后，祁煜洺就拉着贺长柏去找封庭深他们，想知道究竟是怎么一回事。
然而，自叶秋雨上台之后，大家都往舞台聚拢，现场宾客众多，他们刚找到封庭深他们，还没过去到封庭深他们身边，他们封庭深和容辞两人的照片就被叶秋雨爆出来了。
这一刻，就算他再傻，也知道叶秋雨上台“揭穿”容辞的这个戏码，肯定不是封庭深和林芜他们刻意安排的了。
看到现场炸锅的模样，祁煜洺看向了容辞和郁默勋那边，咬了咬牙，忍不住跟贺长柏说道：“现在……有点糟了。”
他怎么也没想到林芜的这个学长，会忽然来这么一下。
封庭深和容辞之间的关系，在圈子里是保密的。
看叶秋雨的态度，估计是把封庭深和容辞之间的事当奸情看待。
面对着叶秋雨泼过来的脏水，容辞为了挽回形象，只怕鱼死网破，也要当众揭开她和封庭深的真实关系了。
不过，祁煜洺也很快就反应了过来，压低声音说道：“不过，就算容辞和庭深关系正当，她上位的手段可不正当，这么说来，庭深他们还是有胜算的。”
说完之后，祁煜洺整个人轻松了一些。
可此刻，孙月清和林立海等人，状态却与祁煜洺相反。
在叶秋雨上台时，孙月清和林芜他们的心弦就一直都是紧绷着的。
因为他们担心事态失控之后，会让事情一发不可收拾，要是惹恼了容辞，他们担心容辞会跟他们鱼死网破，把她和封庭深，还有她和他林家，孙家之间的关系，全都摆到了明面上。

这就是为什么，明明他们这么希望林芜能成为陆博士的学生的情况下，在得知陆博士不收林芜，改收容辞当学生时，他们虽然愤怒，却还是把一切情绪都咽了下去。
看着郁默勋和叶秋雨吵得越发不可开交，他们就越是提心吊胆。
但他们心底还是有一丝庆幸的，因为叶秋雨不知道容辞和封庭深之间的关系，在事情还没发展到完全不可开交时，容辞不见得会把她和封庭深之间的关系爆出来。
毕竟，她和郁默勋之间也不清白，就算她把她和封庭深之间的事情爆了出来，她自己也占不到多少便宜。
然而，他们怎么也没想到，在他们想办法让叶秋雨停下来时，叶秋雨却给了他们这么大的惊喜！
看到封庭深和容辞的亲密照的那一刻，就算是一直冷静冷清如孙月清，也直接怔愣得后退了一步，手中的酒撒了出来，湿了她的礼服。

Volume 1 Chapter 653 Chance of Winning (Page 1)
To be honest, they were all quite surprised by what happened tonight.
None of them expected that the senior who had introduced Lin Wu to Changmo would suddenly come on stage tonight and arouse public opinion.
Qi Yuming was a little confused and asked He Changbai, "Is this a drama deliberately arranged by Ting Shen and the others? Why haven't I heard Ting Shen talk about it?"
He Changbai shook his head: "I don't know, Ting Shen didn't tell me either."
After that, Qi Yuming took He Changbai to find Feng Tingshen and the others, wanting to know what was going on.
However, after Ye Qiuyu came on stage, everyone gathered towards the stage. There were many guests present. As soon as they found Feng Tingshen and the others, before they could get to Feng Tingshen and the others, photos of Feng Tingshen and Rong Ci were exposed by Ye Qiuyu.
At this moment, no matter how stupid he was, he knew that the drama of Ye Qiuyu coming on stage to "expose" Rong Ci was definitely not deliberately arranged by Feng Tingshen and Lin Wu.
Seeing the appearance of the frying pan at the scene, Qi Yuming looked at Rong Ci and Yu Moxun, gritted his teeth, and couldn't help but said to He Changbai: "Now... it's a bit bad."
He never expected that Lin Wu's senior would come suddenly like this.
The relationship between Feng Tingshen and Rong Ci is kept secret in the circle.
Judging from Ye Qiuyu's attitude, he probably regarded the matter between Feng Tingshen and Rong Ci as adultery.
Faced with the dirty water thrown by Ye Qiuyu, Rong Ci had to reveal her true relationship with Feng Tingshen in public in order to save her image, fearing that everything would be lost.
However, Qi Yuming quickly reacted and lowered his voice and said: "However, even if Rong Ci and Ting Shen have a legitimate relationship, her method of getting to the top is not legitimate. In this way, Ting Shen and the others still have a chance of winning."
After saying that, Qi Yuming felt a little more relaxed.
But at this moment, Sun Yueqing, Lin Lihai and others were in the opposite state to Qi Yuming.
When Ye Qiuyu came on stage, Sun Yueqing and Lin Wu's hearts were always tense.
Because they were worried that if the situation got out of control, things would get out of hand. If Rong Ci was offended, they were worried that Rong Ci would fight them to the death and put her relationship with Feng Tingshen, as well as her with the Lin family and the Sun family, all on the surface.
That's why, even though they clearly hoped that Lin Wu could become Dr. Lu's student, when they learned that Dr. Lu would not accept Lin Wu and accepted Rong Ci as his student, although they were angry, they still swallowed all their emotions.
Seeing Yu Moxun and Ye Qiuyu arguing more and more, they became more and more worried.
But they were still a little bit lucky in their hearts, because Ye Qiuyu didn't know about the relationship between Rong Ci and Feng Tingshen, and Rong Ci might not necessarily expose the relationship between her and Feng Tingshen before things got too serious.
After all, she and Yu Moxun were not clear-cut. Even if she exposed the affair between her and Feng Tingshen, she would not be able to gain much advantage.
However, they never expected that when they were trying to make Ye Qiuyu stop, Ye Qiuyu would give them such a big surprise!
The moment she saw the intimate photo of Feng Tingshen and Rong Ci, even Sun Yueqing, who had always been calm and aloof, took a step back in shock, spilling the wine in her hand and soaking her dress.
